commands:
sni_cleanup_nft() {
  sni_tables=$(nft list tables) || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$sni_tables" | grep -q '^table inet forwardx$' || return 0
  sni_rules=$(nft -a list table inet forwardx) || return 1
  sni_handles=$(printf '%s\n' "$sni_rules" | awk -v marker='comment "fwx-sni-splitter-[0-9]+:' '/^[[:space:]]*chain / {chain=$2} chain == "sni_input" && $0 ~ marker {if ($NF !~ /^[0-9]+$/) exit 1; print $NF}') || return 1
  for sni_handle in $sni_handles; do nft delete rule inet forwardx sni_input handle "$sni_handle" || :; done
  sni_rules=$(nft -a list table inet forwardx) || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$sni_rules" | awk -v marker='comment "fwx-sni-splitter-[0-9]+:' '/^[[:space:]]*chain / {chain=$2} chain == "sni_input" && $0 ~ marker {found=1} END {exit found ? 1 : 0}'
}
sni_cleanup_iptables() {
  sni_binary=$1
  sni_rules=$("$sni_binary" -w 5 -S) || return 1
  sni_deletions=$(printf '%s\n' "$sni_rules" | awk -v marker='--comment "?fwx-sni-splitter-[0-9]+:' '/^-A / && $0 ~ marker {sub(/^-A /, "-D "); print}') || return 1
  if [ -n "$sni_deletions" ]; then
    command -v "$sni_binary-restore" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
    printf '*filter\n%s\nCOMMIT\n' "$sni_deletions" | "$sni_binary-restore" --noflush --wait 5 || :
  fi
  sni_rules=$("$sni_binary" -w 5 -S) || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$sni_rules" | awk -v marker='--comment "?fwx-sni-splitter-[0-9]+:' '/^-A / && $0 ~ marker {found=1} END {exit found ? 1 : 0}'
}
sni_cleanup_status=0
sni_cleanup_backends=0
if command -v nft >/dev/null 2>&1; then sni_cleanup_backends=1; sni_cleanup_nft || sni_cleanup_status=1; fi
if command -v iptables >/dev/null 2>&1; then sni_cleanup_backends=1; sni_cleanup_iptables iptables || sni_cleanup_status=1; fi
